assessment: This study describes a new mechanism involving Samd14 and F-actin capping protein (CP) complex formation in the regulation of stress erythropoiesis. Through orthogonal biochemical, cellular, and genetic complementation assays, the authors provide evidence that the Samd14-CP interaction is required for the proper regulation of SCF/Kit signaling in erythroid precursors in response to acute anemia. The Samd14-CP-mediated mechanism may have implications in modulating the receptor tyrosine kinase signaling in physiological and pathological conditions.
